title: Job queues (pg-boss)
description: Queue depth, oldest-job age, terminal failures, retries and dead-letter depth for a product's pg-boss schema. Every panel is one SQL query over the pgboss schema; time series come from pgboss.queue_stats (constructor option persistQueueStats), so the queue_stats snapshot interval (monitorIntervalSeconds, default 60 s) is the resolution. Spike WP-6, see docs/adr/0001-job-queue.md.

panels.title: Queue depth — jobs ready to run

targets.rawSql: SELECT captured_on AS time, name AS metric, ready_count AS value FROM pgboss.queue_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(captured_on) ORDER BY 1
SELECT captured_on AS time, name AS metric, ready_oldest_seconds AS value FROM pgboss.queue_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(captured_on) AND ready_oldest_seconds IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
SELECT delta_on AS time, name AS metric, failed_delta::float8 / delta_seconds * 60 AS value FROM pgboss.queue_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(delta_on) AND delta_seconds > 0 ORDER BY 1
SELECT captured_on AS time, name AS metric, active_count AS value FROM pgboss.queue_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(captured_on) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Retrying now (failed an attempt, waiting for the next)

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS queue, count(*) AS retrying, max(retry_count) AS max_attempt FROM pgboss.job WHERE state = 'retry' GROUP BY name ORDER BY name

panels.title: Dead-letter queues — jobs waiting to be handled

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.name AS dead_letter_queue, count(j.id) AS waiting FROM pgboss.queue d LEFT JOIN pgboss.job j ON j.name = d.name AND j.state IN ('created', 'retry') WHERE d.name IN (SELECT dead_letter FROM pgboss.queue WHERE dead_letter IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY d.name
